steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Gokana-street, Bori Metropolis. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1420 | 1.44 | 1.44
2 | 859 | 1.49 | 2.93
3 | 987 | 14.5 | 17.4
4 | 2246 | 33.5 | 50.9
5 | 34337 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HAK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Gokana-street, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Gokana-street, Bori Metropolis**

The 5-layer sounding profile exhibits the following interpreted resistivity sequence: Layer 1 (1420 Ω·m, depth 1.44 m), Layer 2 (859 Ω·m, depth 2.93 m), Layer 3 (987 Ω·m, depth 17.4 m), Layer 4 (2246 Ω·m, depth 50.9 m), and Layer 5 (34,337 Ω·m).

Evaluation of consecutive layer triplets (r1 > r2 < r3, r2 < r3 < r4, and r3 < r4 < r5) yields an **HAA** curve type. The on-file classification of **HAK** is inconsistent with the model data, as resistivity increases monotonically from Layer 3 through Layer 5, forming an A-type rather than a K-type final branch. The drilling crew should anticipate steadily increasing formation resistivity with depth.

{"curve_type_stated": "HAK", "label_issue_flagged": true}
